name: ai.boltclaw/docs
title: Bolt Claw documentation
description: Search and read the Bolt Claw API documentation. Read-only, and no key needed.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find documentation pages about a subject. Returns an id, a title, a URL and a matching line for each hit, best first. Pass the id to `fetch` to read the page.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words. Matched against titles, sections and text.

limit.description: How many results to return. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one documentation page in full, as markdown. The id is what `search` returns, which is the page's path without /docs/ - for example `authentication` or `api/pages`.

id.description: A page id from `search`, such as "errors" or "api/posts".
